title: Eagles 'going to lean into' Tush Push in 2026, Sean Mannion says

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles 'going to lean into' Tush Push in 2026, Sean Mannion says
sources.description: The 'Tush Push' has been one of the Eagles' best plays over the last five years. Sean Mannion plans to lean on it in his first season as Philly's OC.
